earthing: PV array (port A) and battery / DC bus (port B): IT (floating) with insulation monitoring (PV-C5), OR one pole earthed by the installation; a FIRST EARTH FAULT may persist (the IMD only alarms). Worst credible case used: either pole at PE potential, so every HV node can sit at the full port voltage to PE.
PV-P75/100/110: ports A and B share BUS- (non-isolated), so they are ONE circuit; pole-to-PE <= 1000 V continuous, 1100 V at the hardware OV trip.

DAB-D60: port 1 (PCS DC bus) and port 2 (battery) are separate IT systems. Port 1 is assumed NOT galvanically tied to the AC mains (PCS with its own LF transformer, or otherwise separated); if the PCS is transformerless, port 1 becomes a mains-connected circuit (grid TOV U0 + 1200 V, mains OVC) and this coordination must be re-run.
DAB inter-port barrier: each port may carry its own first fault at opposite poles (port 1 + pole and port 2 - pole at PE), so the transformer sees V1 + V2 = 1850 V DC plus one switching overshoot.
PELV 24 V system: earthed at one point (PELV 0 V bonded to PE), window 21.6-26.0 V (D-013). DVC A.
Field I/O (isolated CAN/RS-485, digital inputs, BMS gateway, Ethernet): DVC A on both sides of their isolators; the BMS communication port is assumed SELV/PELV per the battery system's own standard.

findings.where: all HV boards (PVCELL-25, GDRV-HB, PV-PORT, PV-PORT-180, DAB60, AUX-HV); PV-C6
findings.finding: All HV-PELV isolator ICs are 8.0-8.5 mm packages (UCC21710, UCC14241-Q1, AMC3330, AMC3302, ISO7720, UCC12050, TPSI3050; only the CNY65B opto has 14 mm). Reinforced at 1000 V DC OVC II needs 8 kV -> 8.0 / 9.2 / 10.4 mm clearance at 2000 / 3000 / 4000 m. The drawn port SPD (DEHN 952515, Up <= 4 kV at In 12.5 kA) gives Up,eff ~4.8 kV with 0.5 m of leads, so the reinforced requirement only drops to 7.65 kV (160 % rule) - the same 8 mm row: the SPD buys nothing for reinforced insulation. These barriers therefore FAIL at 3000 and 4000 m. Coating does not help clearance, and PV-C6 '> 3000 m derating' cannot be met by power derating (insulation does not derate).
findings.evidence: this report sec. 3-4; datasheets: UCC21710.pdf p6, UCC14241-Q1.pdf p7, AMC3330.pdf p6, AMC3302.pdf p6, ISO7721.pdf p10, UCC12050.pdf p5, TPSI3050-Q1.pdf p6 (CLR 8-8.5 mm)
findings.recommendation: Owner decision (ECO-10 / PV-C6): (a) claim 2000 m; or (b) fit SPDs whose effective pole-PE level incl. leads is <= 4.0 kV (e.g. Up 2.5 kV pole-PE with <= 0.5 m leads), rated for the target altitude, with a monitored remote contact that stops the converter - then reinforced = 6 kV -> 5.5 / 6.3 / 7.1 mm and the 8 mm packages pass to 4000 m; or (c) isolators with >= 10.4 mm clearance or IEC 60664-3 Type 2 encapsulation qualified at the altitude-corrected impulse.

findings.finding: Barrier surge rating VIOSM 6250 V (no VIMP given; VDE 0884-11 edition) is below the 8 kV reinforced impulse and below the 7.65 kV left after the drawn SPD credit: FAIL at every altitude.
findings.evidence: sensing/AMC3302.pdf p6 (VIOSM 6250 VPK, test 10 kV); power-supply/UCC12050.pdf p5 (VIOSM 6250 VPK)
findings.recommendation: Either the SPD credit of IC-01 option (b) (reinforced 6 kV <= 6.25 kV), or replace by parts rated VIMP >= 8 kV and VIOSM >= 10 kV (check current TI revisions of AMC3302 / a 5 kVrms DC/DC with a 60747-17 VIMP rating).

findings.where: PV-PORT, PV-PORT-180, DAB60 (AMC3330 x6/x6/x6); PVCELL-25, GDRV-HB, DAB60 (UCC14241-Q1)
findings.finding: AMC3330 VIMP 7700 V and UCC14241-Q1 VIMP 7692 V are below the 8 kV reinforced impulse: they pass only with an SPD credit (7.65 kV with the drawn 952515: 0.5-0.7 % margin - not a design margin). AMC3330 / AMC3302 VISO 4250 V rms is also below the conservative reinforced AC test (4400 V rms, TOV rule) and passes only the lenient 2U+1000 rule (4243 V rms).
findings.recommendation: Resolve together with IC-01 (SPD credit) and confirm the reinforced AC test level for DC circuits in the purchased EN 62477-1; otherwise choose parts with VIMP >= 8 kV.

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 K202, K403; DAB60 K1202, K1402 (Omron G7L-2A-X DC24 precharge relay)
findings.finding: The relay coil is driven from the PELV DO, its contacts sit on the 1000 V poles: this is protective separation (reinforced). The datasheet gives only 4000 V AC coil-contacts (1 min) and 10 kV impulse - below the 4243 V rms reinforced AC test by either rule - and states no insulation type, creepage or clearance.
findings.recommendation: Get Omron's VDE 40045061 certificate content (insulation category coil-contact); if it is not reinforced for >= 1000 V, feed the coil from its own isolated supply (the supply barrier then adds the second insulation) or use a relay with a stated reinforced coil-contact rating.

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 K201, K401, K402; DAB60 K1201, K1401 (TDK HVC43-MC)
findings.finding: Coil and mirror (FB) contact are PELV, main contacts HV: reinforced needed. TDK gives 4400 V AC contact-to-coil and Uimp 8 kV (IEC 60947-4-1) - consistent with reinforced at <= 2000 m - but no insulation type and no creepage, and p11 asks to separate or shield the LV side. At 3000 / 4000 m the 8 kV air rating derates to ~7.2 / 6.6 kV < 8 kV.
findings.recommendation: Ask TDK to confirm reinforced (or double) insulation coil + aux vs main circuit for 1000 V DC, OVC II, PD2 and the target altitude; route coil/FB wiring away from the HV studs with reinforced spacing (layout table).

findings.where: PVCELL-25, GDRV-HB, DAB60 (UCC14241-Q1); gen/gdrv.py design_check
findings.finding: UCC14241-Q1 certification is still 'planned' in the datasheet (D-016 risk) and its VIORM 1414 Vpk leaves 11 % margin over the PV switch-node recurring peak (1273 V at 1000 V; 1401 V at the 1100 V trip corner = 1 %). The gdrv design check compares only VIOWM with the 1000 V DC bus - it misses VIORM vs the switch node and the 8 kV impulse (VIMP 7692 V).
findings.evidence: gate-drivers/UCC14241-Q1.pdf p7, p12; hardware/GDRV-HB/outputs/GDRV-HB_design_check.txt ('Barrier vs 1000 V DC bus')
findings.recommendation: Add VIORM >= switch-node recurring peak and VIMP >= reinforced impulse to gdrv.design_check(); hold the VDE certificate as a release condition (D-016).

findings.where: PVCELL-25 Q301-Q308 (MSC035SMA170B4 on the PE heatsink)
findings.finding: The heatsink insulation of the TO-247-4 tabs (drain = A+/B+ or a switch node: 1273 V recurring at 32 kHz, 85 V/ns) is basic insulation and is not specified at all: no pad, no thickness, no bushing/clip, Rth 0.35 K/W is an estimate. Requirement: basic for 1000 V DC, impulse 6 kV, AC 2200 V rms, PD-free (extinction >= 1528 Vpk, test 1910 Vpk <= 10 pC), pad overhang >= creepage 5.0 mm (PD2) / 16.0 mm (PD3 air path) and >= clearance 5.5 / 6.3 / 7.1 mm (2000/3000/4000 m).
findings.evidence: gen/pvcell.py MSC035SMA170B4 desc ('insulated mount'); sim/out/pv_design/report.md (case-sink 'insulated, estimate')
findings.recommendation: Specify the pad (ceramic AlN/Al2O3 or a PD-qualified film), mounting (clip or insulated bushing for the PE screw), overhang, and add a PD type test on the assembled heatsink; re-run the thermal model with its real Rth.

findings.where: DAB60 T1101 (transformer), L1101 (series inductor), both cold-plate mounted
findings.finding: Only the winding-to-winding class is given ('basic (pending system decision)', 1850 V DC basis, PD/hipot 'TBD by ECO-10'); winding-to-core / cold-plate (PE) insulation of T1101 and L1101 is not specified at all. Coordinated levels: P1-P2 basic (simple separation) 1850 V DC, 2100 Vpk recurring at 100 kHz -> PD <= 10 pC at 3150 Vpk, AC 3323 V rms, impulse 6 kV, creepage 10.0 mm (group I) / 20.0 mm (IIIa) PD2; windings-core basic: PD at 1800 Vpk, AC 2200 V rms; windings-NTC reinforced: PD at 2250 Vpk, AC 4400 V rms, impulse 8 kV.
findings.evidence: sim/out/dab_design/dab_spec.json transformer.isolation, series_inductor; gen/dab60.py XF_DESC / LS_DESC
findings.recommendation: Write these levels into dab_spec transformer.isolation and series_inductor (and the RFQ): the 'pending' class is resolved - basic (simple separation) at 1850 V DC is the requirement.

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 L201, L401; DAB60 L1201, L1401 (CUSTOM CM choke)
findings.finding: The CM-choke spec gives '+4 kV surge' winding-core: below the 6 kV basic impulse and below the 4.78 kV left with the drawn SPD credit; no AC test or creepage is stated.
findings.recommendation: Specify winding-core and winding-winding: basic, 1000 V DC, impulse >= 6 kV, AC 2200 V rms 60 s, creepage >= 5.0 mm (PD2) / 16.0 mm (PD3).

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 C201, C202, C401, C402; DAB60 C1201, C1202, C1401, C1402 (X capacitor RFQ)
findings.finding: RFQ impulse >= 4.5 kV pole-pole is below the effective pole-pole SPD level with leads (4.78 kV for the drawn SPDs) and below 6 kV without credit.
findings.recommendation: Raise the RFQ to >= 6 kV (no SPD dependency) or keep the capacitor leads at the SPD terminals and require >= Up,eff + 10 %.

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 U603, U604 (TPSI3050, IMD test switches); gen/port.py imd()
findings.finding: The IMD switch secondaries are declared in the PE domain, but with the switch open the PE-side SiC of the common-source pair blocks and the source/gate island follows the pole through the other FET's body diode: BUS- sits ~V/2 below PE in normal operation (up to 1000 V with a fault). U603/U604 are therefore HV-PELV reinforced barriers (TPSI3050 is reinforced, so the part passes) and IMDx_SRC/G/DRV/VDDH/VDDM/SW are HV nets.
findings.evidence: hardware/PV-PORT/outputs/PV-PORT_netlist.xml (Q601/Q602, Q603/Q604 sources on IMDx_SRC, one drain on PE)
findings.recommendation: Declare those nets HV (or their own floating domain) in port.imd() so the build check and the layout apply reinforced spacing to PELV and basic spacing to PE.

findings.finding: SPD status is not monitored (952515 FM contact not wired; 59.D040 has no remote contact - 59.D041 has), so a disconnected SPD goes unnoticed and no insulation inside the module may rely on its protection level. UCPV 1000 V is below the PV 1100 V OV trip and the DAB port-1 1048 V load-rejection peak. 59.D040 is rated only to 3000 m.
findings.evidence: protection/ProTec-T2-1000DCGU-3Y.pdf p1 (altitude 3000 m, RC optional); gen/port.py block note ('remote-signal contact not wired')
findings.recommendation: Use the -R / FM variants, wire the contact to a SYS-IO-AUX DI and stop the converter on it; confirm 1100 V tolerance with the SPD makers; pick SPDs rated for the claimed altitude.

findings.where: sim/out/port_design/report.md sec. 9 and PA-08; gen/port.py root note
findings.finding: The surge table rates reinforced barriers against Up = 4 kV ('AMC3330 VIMP 7700 V, margin 1.93', 'AMC3302 VIOSM 6250 V, margin 1.56'): with an SPD credit the reinforced requirement is 160 % of Up,eff (>= 6.4 kV for Up 4 kV alone, 7.65 kV with leads), not Up; without credit it is 8 kV. PA-08's 'clearance at 3000 m to be confirmed' resolves to: 8 mm packages do not meet it (9.2 mm).
findings.recommendation: Replace the margin column with the coordinated requirement (this report sec. 3).

findings.where: hardware/DAB60/outputs/DAB60_design_check.txt (Insulation, item 4)
findings.finding: 'HV1/HV2 -> PELV only through reinforced parts: UCC12050 VIOWM 1697 VDC, AMC3330 1700 VDC, ISO7720F 2121 VDC vs 1000 V DC working' is incomplete and not sufficient: HV1/HV2 also reach PELV through the gate drivers and their bias modules, TPSI3050, AMC3302, the HVC43 / G7L coils, the shunt-NTC pads and the transformer NTC; and VIOWM alone does not cover the 8 kV impulse that UCC12050 (VIOSM 6250 V) and AMC3330 (VIMP 7700 V) do not meet.
findings.recommendation: Base the DAB60 insulation check on this audit (or import its verdicts) instead of VIOWM only.

findings.where: AUX-HV T301 (CUSTOM flyback transformer); sim/out/aux_hv_design/report.md sec. 11
findings.finding: The T1 spec says reinforced 'for 1000 V DC working', but the primary drain end carries a 1323 V recurring peak at 65 kHz (1428 V at the 1100 V trip); TIW certified for 1000 V DC working says nothing about PD at that stress. Coordinated levels: PD <= 10 pC at 2481 Vpk (extinction >= 1985 Vpk), AC 4400 V rms 60 s, impulse 8 kV, creepage 20 mm PD2 (bobbin CTI not stated -> IIIa) or 6.4 mm PD1 and >= clearance.
findings.evidence: gen/aux_hv.py T1 description; sim/out/aux_hv_design/aux_hv_spec.json summary.vds_cont / vds_trans
findings.recommendation: Add these levels to the T1 description and the RFQ; require a PD test on every transformer.

findings.where: PVCELL-25 L401 (CUSTOM inductor), CS501 (LA 150-P + lead A)
findings.finding: The inductor winding is a switch node (1273 V recurring at 32 kHz). Its spec gives the embedded-NTC insulation only as 'reinforced for 1000 V DC working' and winding-core as 'basic' with no levels. Coordinated: NTC-winding reinforced PD <= 10 pC at 2387 Vpk, AC 4400 V rms, impulse 8 kV; winding-core basic PD at 1910 Vpk, AC 2200 V rms, impulse 6 kV. The LA 150-P (basic 1000 V, PD test 1.3 kV rms = 1838 Vpk) plus the screened lead A (supplementary, 'PD-free above 2.1 kV peak') form double insulation - acceptable, but the lead must be type-tested to the basic levels.
findings.recommendation: Add the levels to L_DESC and the RFQ.

findings.where: PVCELL-25, GDRV-HB, DAB60, AUX-HV boards (PV-PORT already has it as PA-08)
findings.finding: Conformal coating to PD1 (IEC 60664-3, Type 1) is REQUIRED over every HV-PELV isolator footprint and its HV copper on all HV boards: 8-8.5 mm package creepage < 10.0 mm reinforced at PD2 (PCB and group I package). Only PV-PORT states it; the DAB60 check even asks for 'reinforced creepage at those 3 footprints per bridge (8 mm bodies)', which is not achievable uncoated. CNY65B (14 mm, CTI 200 -> 20 mm needed at PD2) needs it too.
findings.recommendation: State the coating requirement on every HV board (root note + layout rule).

findings.where: mechanical zoning; ECO-10 'PD3 external'; PV-12 forced air, PV-C6 IP20
findings.finding: The PV module is forced-air cooled at IP20: boards and fuses in the cooling-air path see outside dust and humidity (the port design puts the fuses in the inlet air). At PD3 basic creepage at 1000 V is 12.5 mm (group I) / 16.0 mm (IIIa) and reinforced 25.0 / 32.0 mm - not achievable on the boards.
findings.evidence: REQUIREMENTS ECO-10, PV-12, PV-C6; sim/out/port_design/report.md (A_T_FUSE 'fuses in the INLET air path')
findings.recommendation: Define PD2 compartments for the boards (or coat all HV boards to PD1); keep only parts with PD3 ratings (terminals, fuse bases, SPDs) in the air path and give them PD3 creepage.

findings.where: DAB60 assembly: port section (both port.port() blocks, io sheet), busbars and harness carrying both ports
findings.finding: Port-1 and port-2 circuits are separated by basic insulation at 1850 V DC (both ports with a first fault at opposite poles): above the 1000 V limit of the printed-wiring creepage columns, so the PCB needs 10.0 mm (CTI >= 600, group I) or 20.0 mm (standard FR-4, IIIa) uncoated at PD2, 7.5 mm coated (PD1), clearance 5.5 / 6.3 / 7.1 mm. This applies wherever port-1 and port-2 conductors meet: the two port blocks on the port board, the transformer terminations, busbars and harnesses.
findings.recommendation: Specify a CTI >= 600 laminate for DAB60 or keep the two port areas on separate boards / coated.

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 RT201, RT401; DAB60 RT1201, RT1401 (shunt NTC on BUS-)
findings.finding: The reinforced pad under the shunt NTC is a requirement in the description only: no part, material, thickness or test level; the probe's own test is 1000 V AC / 1 s.
findings.recommendation: Specify the pad: reinforced, AC 4400 V rms, impulse 8 kV, creepage around the tag >= 10.0 mm (PD2) and >= the clearance at the claimed altitude; or use a double-insulated probe.

findings.where: PV-PORT / PV-PORT-180 / DAB60 RST 200 resistors, 3100U thermostats, NH fuse bases, DC terminals; DAB60 DD600N16K and CBB011M12GM4T base plates
findings.finding: HV-PE basic insulation of chassis parts is only partly documented: no impulse/creepage data (RST 200: 3.5 kV rms only; DD600N16K: 3.0 kV rms 1 min; CBB011M12GM4T: Visol 3 kV, no PD data at the 100 kHz AC-node stress; fuse bases: Uimp 8 kV only); thermostat pad and DC-terminal creepage are text requirements without values.
findings.evidence: protection/Miba-RST-200.pdf p1; power-semiconductors/DD600N16K.pdf p2; CBB011M12GM4T.pdf p3; protection/NH-gPV-1000VDC.pdf p2
findings.recommendation: Collect creepage/impulse (and for the module PD) data from the makers; give the DC terminals PD3 creepage 12.5 mm (group I) / 16.0 mm (IIIa) to PE.

findings.where: PVCELL-25, GDRV-HB, DAB60 DESAT strings (3 x US1M, SMA); MSC035SMA170B4 pins; CBB011M12GM4T terminals
findings.finding: Functional insulation inside the power stage is below the PD2 table values: SMA pad gap 1.5 mm vs 2.5 mm per diode; TO-247-4 drain-to-source/gate pads ~0.5 mm (2.54 mm pitch, no package creepage data) vs 5.0 mm; module terminal-to-terminal creepage 6.3 mm (CTI 200) vs 10 mm.
findings.evidence: power-semiconductors/US1M.pdf p4; MSC035SMA170B4.pdf p9-10; CBB011M12GM4T.pdf p3
findings.recommendation: Coat the power-stage boards to PD1 and add a milled slot between the drain pin and pins 2-4 of each TO-247-4; confirm by the EN 62477-1 functional-insulation short-circuit test.

findings.where: production test (all HV boards / module)
findings.finding: The module hipot HV-PE (2200 V rms or 3111 V DC) and HV-PELV (4400 V rms) cannot be applied with the SPDs (UCPV 1000 V), the IMD SiC switches (1700 V) and the Y capacitors (1500 V DC) connected; the dividers take 674 V per element (TNPV1206 700 V).
findings.recommendation: Write the hipot procedure: SPDs plugged out, IMD and Y-capacitor paths opened (or a DC test below their ratings), isolator barriers tested at component level (VISO) and the boards' spacing by measurement.
